info.name: Chat App Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for production verification.

IMPORTANT AUTH NOTES:
1. Login sets HttpOnly cookies on path `/api/auth` only.
2. Domain routes (`/api/users`, …) require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.
3. Login test script copies `chat_session_access` cookie value into `accessToken`.
4. Admin folder uses `{{adminToken}}` (login as ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN user first).
5. Default error shape: `{ error: { code, message, fieldErrors?, retryable? } }`.

request.description: Public (+ login rate limit). Sets chat_session + chat_session_access cookies (path /api/auth). Body: { user }. Extract access cookie → accessToken via test script.
Same as login; stores adminToken for Admin folder.
Also accepts refresh cookie on /api/auth path. 200 { user }.
